_about: CI floors for python -m evals.retrieval_eval --check and tests/test_retrieval_eval.py. Set a little below the current numbers so real regressions fail but tiny re-labels don't. 'no_worse_than' rows are [better_mode, baseline_mode, metric]. hybrid >= bm25 is deliberately NOT gated: on this toy set BM25 alone wins (see README). 'abstention' caps the error rates of the shipped insufficient-evidence threshold on the unanswerable probes.
